title: Lysa NDE 6110
content: I was sleeping in the ward I heard lady patients calling for nurses because I was making funny breathing and choking noises. I remember being pushed along the corridors and through the ward doors to the theatre. Still in my body I watched the surgeons take blood soaked swabs from my mouth and drop them into a plastic bucket I saw the oxygen tanks around the room. Then I floated up to the ceiling and I could see through the wall to another room and I recognised young women from my ward sleeping in their beds. Then I was in a viewing gallery with a very tall woman who held my hand. She was strong, serious and in charge of me. We watched my dad come into the theatre to see me as the doctors thought I was going to die. I didn't feel sorry for my dad or particularly want to go back. The woman holding my hand told me I had to get into my body. I said I was scared that I didn't know how to do it. She said go down now. I said what shall I tell them about it. Then I was in my body again and a nurse was stroking my face. I said what I used to hear in the movies "Where am I" although I knew exactly what had happened. I stayed in hospital for 3 weeks and I told mum and she told the nurses but nothing more was said. When I got home I became talented at drawing and poetry and I became a serious little girl who was knowing.

arrival.other_being_detail: A "very tall woman" who held her hand; described as strong, serious, and in charge.

environment.environment_other_detail: A "viewing gallery" overlooking the theatre; also perceived another room through a wall with young women sleeping in beds.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hospital ward emergency with choking/funny breathing; taken to theatre where surgeons removed blood-soaked swabs from her mouth; doctors thought she was going to die.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Observed medical staff and equipment; saw through a wall into another room; watched father enter the theatre from a viewing gallery with a tall woman holding her hand.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with veridical-style observations in the theatre, then ceiling/through-wall perception, then a viewing gallery with a tall woman, then instructed return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived through a wall into another room and recognized young women from her ward sleeping; presence of a "viewing gallery" overlooking the theatre with a tall woman holding her hand.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Then I floated up to the ceiling"; "I could see through the wall to another room"; "The woman holding my hand told me I had to get into my body."; "She said go down now."; "When I got home I became talented at drawing and poetry".
